subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat poll session: direct text reply not delivered to QQ user

question: Should heartbeat delivery be allowed to inherit `lastTo` when the requested heartbeat channel differs from the session `lastChannel` for QQ C2C, or should these notifications require explicit `target`/`to` or message-tool delivery?
rationale: The small code change proposed earlier would make the user-visible QQ case work, but it crosses the same session-routing boundary that protects against cross-channel message leakage, and there is no live QQ proof yet.

options.title: Keep Strict Routing
options.body: Require explicit heartbeat `target`/`to` or message-tool sends for this case, and update docs/troubleshooting so QQ users do not expect implicit cross-channel inheritance.

options.title: Allow Heartbeat-Only Inheritance
options.body: Approve a narrow heartbeat-only relaxation with live QQ C2C proof plus tests showing normal turns and non-QQ channel mismatches still do not leak messages.

options.title: Wait For Reconnect PR First
options.body: Land or close the adjacent qqbot reconnect PR first, then ask for a fresh QQ heartbeat repro to confirm whether any direct-text target issue remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Strict Routing
recommendation.body: Require explicit heartbeat `target`/`to` or message-tool sends for this case, and update docs/troubleshooting so QQ users do not expect implicit cross-channel inheritance.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the relevant target-routing history and merged the security-sensitive shared-session routing guard.
